# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v5.0.0

这是行舟的第五个大版本。它改的是一件很具体的事：**你早上被要求回忆一个自己根本记不住的数字，而那个数字本来可以在前一晚当场记下来。**

「昨晚熄灯」一直存在，但记录方式有结构性问题：它是第二天早上的一个必填时间框。实测 20 天里只填了 12 天，其余 8 天只能标「12 点后（熬夜）」——不是不想记，是回忆不出来。于是这个字段既不可靠、又不产生行为约束：它记录的是后果，不是承诺。

v5.0.0 把这件事拆成两半：**睡前当场记下真实时刻**，**次日早晨回答一句判断**。同时把「手表入睡时间」接进来，并且明确它**只做记录、不参与任何评价**。

## 新增：熄灯计划达成

- **睡前按一次「此刻熄灯」**：在「睡前准备」里点一下就把当前时刻写入当天记录。归日就是当晚，因此不需要新建或写入次日记录——写入路径仍是你已有的单记录保存流程（轮换备份、写后复核、串行队列都不变）。
- **早晨回答一句「昨晚我按计划熄灯了吗」**：
  - 有计划 **且** 已记实测 → **自动判定**，容差 15 分钟；早于计划一律算守住（提前熄灯不是违规）。
  - 有计划但没记实测 → 只在这里问一次；**不要求你填具体时刻**。
  - 没登记计划的夜晚 → 自动「不适用」，不计入达成率、也不再占着待补清单。
  - 判定为「没按计划」→ 必填一句原因，且不填完不落库（保存条会明确写出缺什么）。
- **判定是派生值，不落库**：由「实际 − 计划」在读取时现算，因此**历史数据不需要迁移**，也不可能出现「存下来的判定与实测互相矛盾」。
- **趋势同步**：「睡眠窗口」摘要给出「计划达成 x/y 晚（容差 15 分钟）」。

用真实数据回放：9 个夜晚有计划，达成 1 晚（09-08，晚 8 分钟）；需要你补回答的只有 2 晚。这组数字以前从未被说出来过——界面只显示一个中性的「实际 23:07」，看不出自己在连续失守。

## 新增：手表入睡时间（只记录，不评价）

- 与「手表睡眠评分」「睡眠时长」**同组**，因为它来自同一块手表。
- 自动算出**「躺下后多久睡着」**，跨午夜正确（23:45 熄灯、00:40 入睡 = 55 分钟）。
- **不参与任何达成判定**，界面上也不加红绿，只有中性说明。理由写进了代码注释：**可控的是熄灯；入睡不受意志直接控制，拿它评价就是惩罚一件你控制不了的事。**

## 变更：睡眠与身体区块重排

- 结构改为「**回顾横条**（只读：昨晚计划 · 达成结论 · 实际时刻）+ **填写区**（今日起床 / 晨起体重 / 主观睡眠质量 / 手表睡眠数据组）」。
- 断点重排为 **单列 / 两列 / 三列**（620px、1100px）；此前 900–1100px 之间会退化成「控件被拉满行」的单列。
- 睡眠区**所有控件统一 320px 上限**：此前普通下拉与评分输入框会被拉满整列，同一列里宽窄混杂。
- 只读的「实际」在横条里是**纯文字**，点「改」才展开时间选择器。

## 变更：边界提醒的卡片抬头改为具体事项

三类卡片（待确认 / 未到点 / 已确认）的抬头以前都是 Checklist 的**条目标题（阶段名）**，例如「午饭」；真正要照做的内容（「随餐鱼油 1 粒；不边吃边工作」）被塞在 10px 灰字里。点「已做」后卡片移到已确认区，抬头**仍然是「午饭」**，看起来像数据出错。

现在抬头是**具体事项**：按第一个分号拆句，第一段当标题、其余进补充行，单句整句当标题；补充行放阶段名、状态与剩余分句；区域抬头同样改用具体事项（「接下来是 12:10 的随餐鱼油 1 粒」）。抬头本来就是阶段名时（如「起床」）不重复。标题 12px/500 → 13px/600，补充行 10px → 11px，「还没到点」不再灰化标题。

## 修复

- **必填项挡住自动保存时没有任何提示**：选「没按计划熄灯」后原因必填，但保存条停在「等待自动保存…」，看起来像保存失灵。现在明确写出缺什么。
- **窄屏卡片内部布局**：`≤980px` 时边界提醒卡片的时刻与标题合到同一格、按钮右侧跨两行，避免窄屏下抬头被挤掉。
- **细则字段的编辑窗口一律写着「下一步行动」**：现在窗口标题、无障碍名与正文都取当前编辑的字段名。
- **切换工作项后「本次行动细则」还显示上一条的内容**：字段值改为直接取自当前条目，切换后立即更新；顺带修掉换工作项时把上一条的「阶段性成果」草稿、模板名与模板面板一起带过来的问题。

## 升级：不需要手动迁移

新增字段（`lightsOffTimeSource`、`lightsOffAdherence`、`lightsOffAdherenceReason`、`hasWatchSleepOnset`、`watchSleepOnsetTime`）全部是可选的附加字段：存量记录解析时按空值处理，缺失「来源」标记的旧记录一律按旧口径（回忆补记）解析，因此**不迁移、不改写任何历史数据**。`checklist.json` 的绑定格式未变。

## 测试与验证

- 专项与全量测试：**605 passed / 3 skipped**（60 个文件）；边界提醒相关专项 44 passed。
- `pnpm run check`：0 errors / 0 warnings。
- 睡眠区几何验收：13 档宽度（1440 / 1280 / 1100 / 1000 / 900 / 860 / 760 / 620 / 520 / 480 / 430 / 400 / 360）× 6 种状态，检查**字段矩形重叠、横向溢出、控件最小高度、控件超宽、同组控件等宽、断点与实测列数一致**；全部通过，且检查器先用「已知重叠」自证有效后才采信结论。
- 构建与安装包校验通过；发布由推送 `v5.0.0` 标签触发 GitHub Actions 自动完成。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v5.0.0

This is Xingzhou's fifth major version, and it fixes one very specific thing: **the morning asked you to recall a number you could not remember, while that number could have been recorded on the spot the night before.**

"Last night's lights-out" had a structural problem: it was a required time box the next morning. Across 20 measured days it was filled on only 12, with the other 8 marked "after midnight (late night)" — not for lack of willingness, but because recall was impossible. The field was therefore neither reliable nor behaviourally binding: it recorded a consequence, not a commitment.

v5.0.0 splits it in two: **record the real time on the spot at bedtime**, and **answer one question the next morning**. It also brings in the watch sleep-onset time and states plainly that it is **recorded only, never judged**.

## Added: lights-out plan adherence

- **Tap "Lights out now" at bedtime**: one tap in Bedtime preparation writes the current time into that day's record. It belongs to that same night, so no next-day record is created or written — saving still goes through the existing single-record path (backup rotation, read-back verification, serial queue unchanged).
- **Answer one question in the morning: "Did I follow last night's lights-out plan?"**
  - A plan **and** a measured time → **derived automatically**, 15-minute tolerance; going to bed early always counts as met.
  - A plan but no measured time → asked exactly once, and **you are not asked for a time**.
  - A night with no plan → "not applicable" automatically: it never counts toward adherence and never sits in the to-fill list.
  - A "missed" verdict → one sentence of reason is required, and nothing is written until it is filled in (the save bar says what is missing).
- **The verdict is a derived value and is never stored**: it is computed from measured minus planned at read time, so **existing data needs no migration** and a stored verdict can never contradict the measured time.
- **Trends follow**: the sleep-window summary reports "plan met x/y nights (15-minute tolerance)".

Replaying your real data: 9 nights had a plan, 1 was met (09-08, 8 minutes late), and only 2 nights need an answer from you. Those numbers had never been said out loud — the interface showed only a neutral "actual 23:07", so a run of missed plans was invisible.

## Added: watch sleep-onset time (recorded, never judged)

- It sits in the **same group** as the watch sleep score and sleep duration, because it comes from the same watch.
- It derives **how long it took to fall asleep**, with midnight crossing handled correctly (lights out 23:45, asleep 00:40 = 55 minutes).
- It is **never part of any adherence verdict**, and the interface gives it neutral copy with no red or green. The reasoning is in the code comment: **lights out is what you control; falling asleep is not under direct voluntary control, and judging it would punish something you cannot govern.**

## Changed: the Sleep & body section was restructured

- Now a read-only **review bar** (last night's plan, verdict, measured time) plus a **fill area** (wake time, morning weight, subjective sleep quality, watch sleep data group).
- Breakpoints are now **one / two / three columns** (620px, 1100px); previously 900–1100px degraded into a single column of full-width controls.
- **Every control in the section is capped at 320px**: previously plain selects and the score input stretched across the whole column, mixing very wide and very narrow controls in one column.
- The read-only measured time is **plain text**; a **Change** button reveals the time picker.

## Changed: boundary reminder cards are headlined by the actual item

All three card groups (to confirm / not yet due / confirmed) used to be headlined with the checklist entry title — the phase name, such as "Lunch" — while the thing you actually had to do ("fish oil with the meal; don't work while eating") sat in 10px grey text. Confirming a card moved it to the confirmed group with the same "Lunch" headline, which looked like a data bug.

The headline is now the **actual item**: split at the first semicolon, the first clause becomes the title and the rest a supporting line, with a single-clause reminder used whole. The supporting line carries the phase name, status and remaining clauses, and section headlines use the actual item too ("Next up is fish oil with the meal at 12:10"). When the headline already is the phase name (for example "Get up") the supporting line does not repeat it. Title size went 12px/500 → 13px/600, supporting line 10px → 11px, and "not yet due" no longer greys out the title.

## Fixed

- **A required field could block autosave without any message**: choosing "did not follow the plan" makes the reason required, but the save bar stayed on "Waiting to autosave…", which looked like saving had broken. It now states what is missing.
- **Narrow-screen card layout**: at `≤980px` the boundary reminder card merges the time and title into one cell and lets the button span two rows on the right, so the headline is no longer squeezed out.
- **Every detail field editor was titled "Next Action"**: the window title, accessible name and content now all name the field being edited.
- **Switching work items left the previous item's Action Details on screen**: field values now come straight from the current item and update immediately; the stale staged-results draft, template name and template panel no longer follow along.

## Upgrading: no manual migration

The new fields (`lightsOffTimeSource`, `lightsOffAdherence`, `lightsOffAdherenceReason`, `hasWatchSleepOnset`, `watchSleepOnsetTime`) are all optional additions: existing records parse them as empty, and old records without a source marker keep the previous semantics (recalled entry). Nothing is migrated and no historical data is rewritten. The `checklist.json` binding format is unchanged.

## Tests and verification

- Targeted and full test runs: **605 passed / 3 skipped** (60 files); the boundary-reminder suites pass 44.
- `pnpm run check`: 0 errors / 0 warnings.
- Sleep-section geometry acceptance: 13 widths (1440 / 1280 / 1100 / 1000 / 900 / 860 / 760 / 620 / 520 / 480 / 430 / 400 / 360) × 6 states, checking **field-rectangle overlap, horizontal overflow, minimum control height, oversized controls, same-group equal widths, and breakpoint-versus-measured-column consistency**. All pass, and the checker proves itself against a known overlap before its results are trusted.
- Production build and package verification pass; publishing is triggered by pushing the `v5.0.0` tag and completed by GitHub Actions.
